text:
Ingrid: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A on release cadence, oncall, quality bars, and SLAs. Short answers below.

Lee: Confirm cadence?

Ingrid: Biweekly major train (Tue 09:00 PT). Weekly infra patches (Thu). Hotfixes ad-hoc with rollback playbook.

Sofia: Oncall: 2-week rotations, primary+secondary. Ack target 10m, mitigation/rollback attempt 30m. Notify CS within 1h if hosted SLA impacted.

Priya: Canary defaults: 5% for 1h -> 25% for 6h -> full. Monitored: eval-quality, token errors, user error-rate, p95/p99 latency. Auto-rollback triggers: quality drop >5% on labeled evals, user error-rate >2x baseline, p99 +40% or p95 +200ms. ML will tune per-model.

Lee: Where are the runbooks?

devbot: Release playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/release-cadence  Canary policy: https://redwood.internal/platform/canary-policy  Incident runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/incident-response

Ingrid: Office hours next Wed 4pm PT to walk the playbook. Priya will update the playbook with canary numbers and RACI by Friday EOD. Tag me if I missed anything.
